title: Grusch: Oppenheimer set up UFO secrecy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Grusch: Oppenheimer set up UFO secrecy, about 1940s-1950s at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: if you believe David grush then they literally set up the secrecy

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that if you believe David Grusch, a former intelligence officer turned whistleblower, then men such as Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the US atomic bomb project, and a scientist named Robert Sarbacher literally set up the secrecy around UFOs in the 1940s and 1950s. If true, it would mean the same people who built the bomb also built the wall of silence around UFOs.
